patchNotes: Fixed main-menu character discovery without a named preset. Current custom models and materials now restore to the menu preview, including the automatic custom-hair fix for hats and busts. Menu restoration only targets the menu character and preserves manual selections made while loading. Added pause-safe restoration, duplicate prevention, and cancellation when the preview character or scene changes. Main-menu runtime logs confirmed dreads, hat, and bust restoration with hair remaining active afterward. Existing presets and automatic emote downloads remain supported; experimental TV and multiplayer-media limitations are unchanged.
